entries.title: Proverbs 5:1
segments: My son, listen to my wisdom; bow your ear to my understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:2
segments: in order to keep discretion, [that] your lips may keep knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:3
segments: For the lips of a strange woman drip honey, and her palate [is] smoother than oil;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:4
segments: but afterward she [is as] bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:5
segments: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:6
segments: lest you should meditate on the path of life, her tracks are movable; you cannot know [them].

entries.title: Proverbs 5:7
segments: And now hear me, O sons, and do not depart from the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:8
segments: Remove your ways far from her, and do not come near the door of her house,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:9
segments: lest you give your honor to others and your years to the cruel;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:10
segments: that strangers not be filled [with] your strength, and your labors [be] in the house of a stranger;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:11
segments: and you moan when your end [comes], when your flesh and muscle are eaten away,

entries.title: Proverbs 5:12
segments: and say, How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised correction;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:13
segments: and I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor bowed down my ears to those who taught me!

entries.title: Proverbs 5:14
segments: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:15
segments: Drink waters out of your own cistern, and running waters out of your own well.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:16
segments: Should your overflowing spring he scattered abroad [as] rivers of waters in the streets.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:17
segments: Let them be only your own, and not strangers' with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:18
segments: Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice with the wife of your youth.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:19
segments: [Like] the loving deer and pleasant doe, let her breasts satisfy you at all times, and be ravished always with her love.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:20
segments: And why will you, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

entries.title: Proverbs 5:21
segments: For the ways of man [are] before the eyes of the LORD, and He watches all his paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:22
segments: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be held with the cords of his sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:23
segments: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
